settings.treatmentSubtitle: Each tailored treatment is an investment in your health and aesthetics. We deliver results that not only heal — but impress.
settings.diagnosticSubtitle: Diagnostic methods allow us to accurately assess the condition of teeth, detect issues at early stages, and develop a personalized treatment plan

treatments.title: Digital Smile Design
treatments.subtitle: Computer Smile Planning
treatments.whatItIs: A modern computerized method that uses computer photos and scans to show you how your new smile will look before any treatment begins.
treatments.howItWorks: Advanced imaging software maps your face and tooth shape to create a virtual 3D preview of your final smile.
treatments.benefits: Gives you total clarity and lets you preview your results beforehand so you feel confident.
procedure: Taking initial photographs and digital scans.
Using the finalized plan to guide treatment.
treatments.result: A predictable, beautifully balanced smile that matches your face.
treatments.whatIfNotDone: You might undergo cosmetic dental treatments without knowing how the final outcome will look.
paragraphs: A modern computerized method that uses computer photos and scans to show you how your new smile will look before any treatment begins.
Advanced imaging software maps your face and tooth shape to create a virtual 3D preview of your final smile.

treatments.title: Dental Implants
treatments.subtitle: Permanent Artificial Teeth
treatments.whatItIs: The best way to replace missing teeth by placing a strong titanium post into the jawbone as a permanent artificial root.
treatments.howItWorks: The titanium root bonds naturally with your jawbone over time, providing a sturdy foundation that looks and chews like a real tooth.
treatments.benefits: Stops your jawbone from getting weak, restores full chewing power, and protects neighboring healthy teeth.
procedure: Minor surgical placement of the titanium post.
Attaching a custom crown matching natural color.
treatments.result: A permanent, strong, and natural-looking tooth replacement.
treatments.whatIfNotDone: Leaving gaps can cause surrounding teeth to drift, bone to weaken, and difficulty chewing.
paragraphs: The best way to replace missing teeth by placing a strong titanium post into the jawbone as a permanent artificial root.
The titanium root bonds naturally with your jawbone over time, providing a sturdy foundation that looks and chews like a real tooth.

treatments.title: Full Mouth Rehabilitation
treatments.subtitle: Complete Smile Makeover
treatments.whatItIs: A complete treatment plan to repair and rebuild all your upper and lower teeth together.
treatments.howItWorks: Combines restorative treatments to fix severe tooth wear, broken teeth, bite problems, or constant jaw pain.
treatments.benefits: Restores full mouth health, improves chewing, and gives you back a healthy mouth step by step.
procedure: Diagnostic evaluation of bite and teeth.
Foundation work like root canals or fillings.
treatments.result: A fully restored, functional, and healthy mouth with a radiant smile.
treatments.whatIfNotDone: Widespread decay, broken teeth, and bad bites will worsen, leading to constant pain and tooth loss.
paragraphs: A complete treatment plan to repair and rebuild all your upper and lower teeth together.
Combines restorative treatments to fix severe tooth wear, broken teeth, bite problems, or constant jaw pain.

treatments.title: Dental Crowns & Bridges
treatments.subtitle: Caps and Fixed Teeth
treatments.whatItIs: Strong protective covers (crowns) for weak or broken teeth, and artificial teeth (bridges) used to fill empty spaces.
treatments.howItWorks: Crowns fit securely over a weak tooth like a helmet to protect it, while bridges use artificial teeth to span across empty gaps.
treatments.benefits: Crowns save weak teeth from breaking, while bridges fill gaps so you can smile and chew without worry.
procedure: Shaping and cleaning the tooth/anchor teeth.
Creating a custom crown or bridge.
treatments.result: A durable, tooth-colored cover or bridge that blends seamlessly.
treatments.whatIfNotDone: A weak tooth can fracture completely, and gaps can cause neighboring teeth to shift.
paragraphs: Strong protective covers (crowns) for weak or broken teeth, and artificial teeth (bridges) used to fill empty spaces.
Crowns fit securely over a weak tooth like a helmet to protect it, while bridges use artificial teeth to span across empty gaps.

treatments.title: Root Canal Treatment
treatments.subtitle: Nerve Treatment to Save the Tooth
treatments.whatItIs: A procedure to clean out a badly infected or aching tooth instead of pulling it out.
treatments.howItWorks: The infected, painful nerve tissue inside the root is safely removed, and the inner space is cleaned and sealed.
treatments.benefits: Takes away your toothache, stops infection from spreading, and lets you keep your natural tooth.
procedure: Creating a small opening to access the nerve.
Sealing roots and placing a protective crown.
treatments.result: A healthy, pain-free tooth that functions normally without discomfort.
treatments.whatIfNotDone: Infection will spread deeper into the bone, causing severe swelling, excruciating pain, and tooth extraction.
paragraphs: A procedure to clean out a badly infected or aching tooth instead of pulling it out.
The infected, painful nerve tissue inside the root is safely removed, and the inner space is cleaned and sealed.

treatments.title: Wisdom Tooth Removal
treatments.subtitle: Painful Back Tooth Surgery
treatments.whatItIs: A safe minor surgery to take out back molar teeth that are stuck, causing pain, or crowding other teeth.
treatments.howItWorks: Using local anesthesia, the dentist gently loosens and removes the troublesome wisdom tooth to relieve pressure.
treatments.benefits: Stops severe pain, prevents gum infections, and keeps your other teeth straight.
procedure: Removing the tooth from its socket.
Placing a small stitch and giving care advice.
treatments.result: Permanent relief from deep jaw pressure, pain, and recurring swelling.
treatments.whatIfNotDone: Impacted wisdom teeth can cause severe crowding of front teeth, cysts, and painful gum infections.
paragraphs: A safe minor surgery to take out back molar teeth that are stuck, causing pain, or crowding other teeth.
Using local anesthesia, the dentist gently loosens and removes the troublesome wisdom tooth to relieve pressure.

treatments.title: Gum Treatment
treatments.subtitle: Care for Bleeding and Weak Gums
treatments.whatItIs: Special care to clean and heal your gums when they bleed, swell, or feel sore.
treatments.howItWorks: Involves deep cleanings below the gumline to remove hardened tartar and bacteria that cause inflammation.
treatments.benefits: Stops your gums from bleeding, removes bad breath, and keeps your teeth firmly anchored.
treatments.result: Pink, firm, healthy gums that do not bleed when brushing.
treatments.whatIfNotDone: Untreated gum disease destroys the jawbone holding your teeth, leading to loose teeth and tooth loss.
paragraphs: Special care to clean and heal your gums when they bleed, swell, or feel sore.
Involves deep cleanings below the gumline to remove hardened tartar and bacteria that cause inflammation.

treatments.title: Orthodontics
treatments.subtitle: Braces and Clear Aligners for Crooked Teeth
treatments.whatItIs: Treatments to straighten crooked teeth and fix bite problems using traditional braces or invisible trays.
treatments.howItWorks: Applies gentle, steady pressure over time to guide your teeth into their correct positions.
treatments.benefits: Gives you a straight smile and makes it much easier to clean your teeth properly.
procedure: Providing a retainer to hold teeth in place.
treatments.result: A straight, beautiful smile and a healthy bite that lasts a lifetime.
treatments.whatIfNotDone: Crooked teeth are hard to clean, leading to higher risks of decay, gum disease, and jaw strain.
paragraphs: Treatments to straighten crooked teeth and fix bite problems using traditional braces or invisible trays.
Applies gentle, steady pressure over time to guide your teeth into their correct positions.

treatments.title: Teeth Whitening
treatments.subtitle: Making Yellow Teeth Bright and Clean
treatments.whatItIs: A safe cosmetic treatment to clean away deep stains and make your yellow or dull teeth sparkling white.
treatments.howItWorks: Uses safe clinical-grade whitening gel that gently breaks down and removes stains caused by tea, coffee, or aging.
treatments.benefits: Removes deep stains and gives you a bright, confident smile instantly.
treatments.result: A visibly whiter, cleaner, and vibrant smile in one visit.
treatments.whatIfNotDone: Yellow or stained teeth will continue to darken with age and diet, affecting your smile confidence.
paragraphs: A safe cosmetic treatment to clean away deep stains and make your yellow or dull teeth sparkling white.
Uses safe clinical-grade whitening gel that gently breaks down and removes stains caused by tea, coffee, or aging.

treatments.title: Restorative Dentistry
treatments.subtitle: Tooth Fillings and Repairs
treatments.whatItIs: Simple treatments using tooth-colored materials to fill cavities and repair broken or decayed teeth.
treatments.howItWorks: The decayed portion of the tooth is cleaned out and filled with a strong composite material that bonds directly to the tooth.
treatments.benefits: Stops tooth decay from getting bigger and brings back your normal chewing strength.
procedure: Hardening with special light and polishing.
treatments.result: A strong, restored tooth that looks natural and functions without pain.
treatments.whatIfNotDone: Small cavities will grow larger, reaching the nerve and causing severe toothaches requiring root canals.
paragraphs: Simple treatments using tooth-colored materials to fill cavities and repair broken or decayed teeth.
The decayed portion of the tooth is cleaned out and filled with a strong composite material that bonds directly to the tooth.

treatments.title: Children Dentistry
treatments.subtitle: Special Dental Care for Kids
treatments.whatItIs: Gentle and friendly dental care specially designed for children and teenagers.
treatments.howItWorks: Focuses on preventive education, stopping tooth worms (cavities) early, and making visits fun and fear-free.
treatments.benefits: Teaches kids how to brush properly, prevents early decay, and ensures a lifetime of healthy smiles.
treatments.result: A healthy set of teeth, strong oral habits, and a happy child.
treatments.whatIfNotDone: Ignored cavities in kids cause severe pain, infections, difficulty eating, and crooked permanent teeth later.
paragraphs: Gentle and friendly dental care specially designed for children and teenagers.
Focuses on preventive education, stopping tooth worms (cavities) early, and making visits fun and fear-free.

treatments.title: Porcelain Veneers
treatments.subtitle: Thin White Shells for Front Teeth
treatments.whatItIs: Very thin, tooth-colored custom shells attached to the front of your teeth to hide flaws.
treatments.howItWorks: A tiny fraction of enamel is gently shaped from the front of the tooth, and the custom porcelain shell is bonded on top.
treatments.benefits: Instantly fixes chipped, stained, cracked, or gapped front teeth for a clean, attractive smile.
procedure: Trimming a thin layer of enamel.
treatments.result: A stunning, stain-resistant, perfectly straight, and dazzling smile.
treatments.whatIfNotDone: Visible chips, severe discoloration, or gaps will remain and cannot be fixed by standard whitening.
paragraphs: Very thin, tooth-colored custom shells attached to the front of your teeth to hide flaws.
A tiny fraction of enamel is gently shaped from the front of the tooth, and the custom porcelain shell is bonded on top.

treatments.title: Dentures
treatments.subtitle: Removable Artificial Teeth
treatments.whatItIs: Removable artificial teeth and gums (available as full or partial sets) designed to replace missing teeth.
treatments.howItWorks: Custom-crafted to fit comfortably over your gums, supporting your facial structure and enabling you to eat and speak normally.
treatments.benefits: Restores a full smile, improves speech clarity, helps you chew food easily, and supports facial muscles.
procedure: Taking measurements and impressions of your mouth.
Creating a trial model to check fit and bite.
Fitting and adjusting them for comfort.
treatments.result: A comfortable, natural-looking set of teeth that restores your confidence and daily functions.
treatments.whatIfNotDone: Missing multiple teeth makes chewing difficult, causes facial sagging around the cheeks and mouth, and affects speech.
paragraphs: Removable artificial teeth and gums (available as full or partial sets) designed to replace missing teeth.
Custom-crafted to fit comfortably over your gums, supporting your facial structure and enabling you to eat and speak normally.

diagnostics.title: Radiological examination
paragraphs: High-precision panoramic and cephalometric digital radiology delivering complete structural insights into tooth roots, bone density, and anatomical canals.
Our ultra-low dose diagnostic units minimize radiation exposure by up to 90% while providing immediate high-resolution digital clarity for accurate clinical evaluation.

diagnostics.title: Periodontal examination
paragraphs: Detailed clinical assessment of gum tissues, measuring periodontal pocket depths with calibrated titanium micro-probes to identify micro-inflammation before bone recession begins.
Essential for safeguarding the foundational biological support of your teeth and planning individualized preventative or regenerative therapy.

diagnostics.title: Tooth sensitivity test
paragraphs: Precise thermal and electrical pulp vitality diagnostics used to evaluate sensory response, detect micro-fractures, and pinpoint concealed nerve inflammation.
Provides immediate clarity to determine whether gentle remineralization, bonding, or targeted endodontic care is required.

diagnostics.title: Digital radiography
paragraphs: Next-generation chairside digital intraoral sensors transmitting instant crystal-clear radiographs directly to high-definition screens.
Enables instant diagnosis during consultation with unmatched diagnostic precision and minimal patient wait time.

diagnostics.title: Computed tomography
paragraphs: Computed tomography is a fast, painless, and precise procedure that creates a 3D image of the teeth, jaw, and tissues.
It helps assess bone structures, detect hidden pathologies, and plan treatment with accuracy. With minimal radiation, it is safe even for frequent use.

diagnostics.title: Occlusal analysis
paragraphs: Digital computerized evaluation of bite forces, tooth contact dynamics, and jaw joint movement using high-precision sensor wands.
Identifies destructive chewing imbalances, relieves TMJ strain, and guarantees the lasting stability of veneers, crowns, and implants.

diagnostics.title: Fluorescence diagnostics
paragraphs: Optical fluorescence wavelength diagnostics illuminating dental enamel to expose hidden subsurface caries and early demineralization.
Allows for biological tooth preservation and non-invasive micro-interventions long before traditional drilling would be required.

diagnostics.title: Bacteriological analysis
paragraphs: Specialized laboratory testing of the oral microbiome to detect specific anaerobic periodontal pathogens and establish biological susceptibility profiles.
Guides targeted, biocompatible antibacterial treatments to eliminate persistent infection and safeguard long-term implant integration.
